identificationModule.briefTitle: V501 Immunogenicity Study in Females Age 9 to 17 Years (V501-028)
identificationModule.officialTitle: V501 Phase II Immunogenicity Study in Females Aged 9 to 17 Years

primaryOutcomes.measure: Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) 6 Serum Antibody Titer at One Month After Completed Vaccination Series
primaryOutcomes.description:
Month 7 HPV Competitive Luminex immunoassay (cLIA) Geometric Mean Titers (GMT) by vaccine group.

The limit of detection of the assay was 7 mMU/ml. GMTs and confidence limits below the limit of detection are shown as "7.0".
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At one month after completed vaccination series (Month 7)
